office_does: The auditor runs county elections, records documents and licenses, and keeps the county's financial accounts.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Auditor Bryan Elliott is the only candidate for a second term.

candidates.summary: First-term Kittitas County Auditor and Army National Guard officer, running unopposed for a second term.
highlights: Elected auditor in 2022, defeating Jerry Pettit [S3]
Installed 24/7 live-view cameras in the Election Center [S1][S3]
Cites three consecutive timely audits with no questioned costs [S1][S3]
